title: CycleSense.ai: Menstrual Health & PCOS Guidance Platform
desc: A dignified, evidence-backed menstrual health platform designed for accurate cycle tracking, nuanced symptom awareness, and compassionate PCOS guidance. Combines empirical cycle science with dual-language AI assistance (English & Bengali) and 100% privacy-protected health insights.
result: Deployed live on Vercel with bilingual health AI (EN/বাং), cycle phase prediction, hormonal symptom awareness, and privacy-first architecture.

title: Bangladeshi Taka Note Detection API
desc: YOLOv11-based computer vision web system and REST API for real-time detection, boundary localization, and classification of Bangladeshi bank currency notes with automated inference.
result: Deployed live on Render with an interactive image upload interface and computer vision inference pipeline.

title: BanglaText: Bengali NLP & Sentiment API
desc: A production-grade natural language processing REST API specialized for the Bengali language. Provides automated text normalization, tokenization, preprocessing, and Bengali sentiment analysis.
result: Fully documented OpenAPI/Swagger endpoints (/process, /sentiment, /health) deployed live on Render for developer integration.

title: OrbitWatch AI: Asteroid Tracking & Orbit Risk Explorer
desc: Scientific exploration and real-time monitoring of Near-Earth Asteroids (NEAs), close approach trajectory calculation, orbital risk assessment, and interactive ephemeris celestial visualization powered by NASA JPL data.
result: Deployed live on Vercel with high-precision orbital tracking, risk index metrics, and interactive celestial dashboard.

title: AeroHealth AI: Aircraft Predictive Maintenance System
desc: End-to-end Machine Learning and Prognostics & Health Management (PHM) system for turbofan engines using NASA C-MAPSS telemetry. Estimates degradation trajectories, Remaining Useful Life (RUL), and delivers maintenance intelligence via a FastAPI REST API and Streamlit cockpit dashboard.
result: Evaluated against NASA PHM 2008 asymmetric penalty scoring with automated feature engineering pipelines and fleet monitoring.
